title: Importance of Self-Assessment in Faith
summary: Regularly assess your faith to guard against hypocrisy.
translation: We should always examine our faith to ensure that no part of hypocrisy resides in our hearts, making us rely on our belief and deeds, thinking that our end will also be with faith. Even great companions like Abu Bakr Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him), Hanzalah As-Sa’idi (may Allah be pleased with him), and Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) feared losing their faith at the end. They continuously assessed their faith and used to tell the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) about their condition to evaluate their lives according to his teachings. They ensured that worldly love, hatred of death, and distance from religion did not ease the path towards disbelief and apostasy, nor strengthened hypocrisy, which could result in losing their faith. Today, among all the tribulations, the greatest danger is losing faith unknowingly. This was emphasized in the teachings of Ali Mehnawi (may Allah have mercy on him), especially amidst the trials faced by Muslims. He stated that people being content with their faith is the gravest trial. Therefore, it is crucial to consistently assess our faith and recognize our spiritual state.
